title: Vibegraph Document Front Matter
description: Schema for the optional YAML front matter of any Core or module document in a vibegraph, per the Vibegraph Specification v1.0 (https://vibegraph.md/SPEC.md).

section.description: A stable logical identifier, usually mirroring the path (e.g. 'core/purpose', 'modules/goals').

visibility.description: Overrides the manifest default_visibility for this document.

scope.description: Required when visibility is 'scoped': the agent/tool identifiers permitted to read this document. Ignored otherwise. An empty scope with visibility 'scoped' MUST be treated as 'private'.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date the document last changed.

then.description: When visibility is 'scoped', a non-empty scope is expected.
